sloka: वयमस्य यथा लोके सङ्ख्याता: सौम्य साधुभि: ।भार्य्या: पुत्राश्च शिष्याश्च त्वमनु ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥ २.१०४.१९॥
transliteration: vayamasya yathā loke saṅkhyātā: saumya sādhubhi: ।bhāryyā: putrāśca śiṣyāśca tvamanu jñātumarhasi ॥ 2.104.19॥

translations.english: O handsome one, you should treat us the way the virtuous treat their wives, sons and disciples in this world.
